item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Investigation update expected in Plant City mother, children, grandmother shooting deaths from May 3
item.description: PCPD said it will hold a press conference on August 13 at 10 a.m. to provide an overview of the investigation and release findings.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump Media says Wall Street firms are paying up to $100K for early access to Trump posts
item.description: Trump Media has signed multiple deals with Wall Street trading firms, charging up to $100,000 per month for early access to Trump's Truth Social posts. Two senators are urging the SEC to investigate.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Car swept off Ohio interstate during powerful storm
item.description: A severe storm system sweeping the Midwest produced damaging winds in Ohio, where a car was blown off Interstate 71 near downtown Columbus.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US existing home sales fall 1.7% in July as record prices, high mortgage rates stifle would be-buyers
item.description: Sales of previously occupied U.S. homes slowed again in July as record prices and the highest mortgage rates in a year prove to be an insurmountable hurdle for many prospective buyers.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump warns replacing FIFA president Infantino would be 'terrible mistake'
item.description: Following intense criticism and calls for him to resign from his role as FIFA president, Gianni Infantino is receiving support from President Donald Trump.
